name: A Scarlet Hammer button is saved as Argent Blade (#5469)
contract: Scarlet Crusader 301172 is bound to aura_ascension_templar_lifecycle; its apply calls AscensionTemplar::Replacement(player, 804929, 807035) (AscensionTemplarAuras.cpp:145-146) and its removal Replacement(player, 804929, 0) (lines 221-222). Replacement (AscensionTemplar.cpp:129-143) learns Scarlet Hammer 807035 with learnSpell(..., true) (line 132) and replaces every known Argent Blade rank (chain of 804929; rank 7 807268 here, as in templar-scarlet-hammer-replaces-argent-blade.json) through SetTemporarySpellReplacement (line 139). The scenario fixtures Scarlet Crusader (8 s). 807035 is never written to character_spell, so a button holding it must be saved as Argent Blade 807268, the spell persisted_action_button reads from Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell; a button holding Argent Blade itself is saved unchanged.

steps.label: Argent Blade is replaced with Scarlet Hammer
The Scarlet Hammer button is saved as Argent Blade
Control: the Argent Blade button is saved unchanged
